corpus_root: ~/Library/Application Support/Sts2Recorder/sessions (read-only scan; the newest part was still being written)
rule_truth: output/server-bootstrap/linux-decompiled (v0.111.0, commit of recorded v0.111.0 parts: 41cef1ea)

method.scripts_note: committed generators, Python 3 stdlib; run from the repo root in the order listed (sim/tools/inventory/classify/README.md)
method.lineage: parts with equal (manifest.run.start_time, seed, character), as sts2rec.lineage.group_lineages
method.combat: room_entered event whose room_model_id starts with ENCOUNTER.; unique = (lineage, act, floor); attempts = re-entries of that room (save&quit or QuickSL reloads)
method.decision: actions.jsonl record (no cancelled records exist); in_combat = the state at state_seq has a battle block, or is a card/hand/bundle select or map view with a later battle snapshot in the same room; move_to_map_coord and ready_to_begin_enemy_turn are follow-ups, not decisions

replay_mcr.which_combat: the last combat won inside that part: RunLifecycle.WriteReplayPostfix copies replays/latest.mcr with File.Copy(overwrite: true) after every CombatReplayWriter.WriteReplay while a recorder session is open; the game writes it on the combat-win path (Combat/CombatManager.cs:1763); its other write, in RunManager.CleanUp (Runs/RunManager.cs:4653-4656), runs after the recorder's CleanUp prefix has closed the session, so it is never archived
replay_mcr.contents: PacketWriter bit stream (Multiplayer.Replay/CombatReplay.cs:33-76): version, gitCommit, modelIdHash, choiceIds, rewardIds, nextActionId/nextChecksumId/nextHookId, serializableRun = RunManager.ToSave(null) captured by CombatReplayWriter.RecordInitialState right after the map-point save and before the room roll (Runs/RunManager.cs:615-618 save, :669-672 RecordInitialState, :681-683 RollRoomTypeFor + CreateRoom), i.e. the same state as that save, events (GameAction NetActions, hook actions, player-choice results, action resumes), checksumData (NetFullCombatState per checksum: creatures, piles in order, potions, relics, orbs, player and run RNG sets)
replay_mcr.decoding_requirements: port PacketReader plus every IPacketSerializable on the path (SerializableRun and nested types, NetAction subtypes, NetPlayerChoiceResult, NetFullCombatState) per game version, and rebuild ModelIdSerializationCache net ids (ContentSorter order over ModelDb.All, epochs, saved-property names; Multiplayer.Serialization/ModelIdSerializationCache.cs:95-140) checked against the header modelIdHash

run_history_run.contents: game JSON at run end: seed, build_id, acts, modifiers, players[] (final deck with floor_added_to_deck, relics, potions, max_potion_slot_count), map_point_history[act][floor] (map_point_type, rooms[] with model_id/monster_ids/turns_taken, player_stats[] with card_choices, relic_choices, potion_choices, event_choices, ancient_choice, rest_site_choices, cards_gained/removed/transformed/enchanted, upgraded/downgraded_cards, bought_*, gold and hp flows)
run_history_run.note: sts2rec/native_run.py accepts schema 8 and 9 only; the 16 schema-10 files are read raw by the exporter

content_seen.definition: ids appearing in hands, played cards, card/hand/reward select lists, relic and potion lists, enemy entity ids, power ids (statuses, power_received), room_entered encounter/event ids

version_diff_v0_107_1_vs_v0_111_0.method: files paired by (namespace, file name); both sides cleaned of comments, attributes, using lines and async/iterator state-machine plumbing; compared per file: (a) multiset of numeric literals outside presentation contexts with 0/1/-1 dropped, plus `Name => constant` properties; (b) multiset of rule enums (CardType, CardRarity, TargetType, CardKeyword, PowerStackType, AscensionLevel, ValueProp, PileType, ...); (c) set of called members with presentation/API-noise names removed; rule_diverging_estimate = any of the three. A raw text diff is useless because the two trees were decompiled with different settings
version_diff_v0_107_1_vs_v0_111_0.precision_note: manual review of all 86 flagged card files: about 85-90 % are real balance or behaviour changes; residual noise = lambda/display-class rendering of 0-valued constants, renamed APIs (ModifyCardPlayResultPileTypeAndPosition -> ModifyCardPlayResultLocation, FromCard(card) -> FromCard(card, play)), presentation-only calls. Potions: 23 flags are TargetType.Self -> TargetType.AnyPlayer (likely inert in single player). Characters: 6 flags are animator-graph noise. Value lists omit 0, 1 and -1, so a change 1 -> 2 reads [] -> [2]

hook_surface.counting_note: regex count over Hooks/Hook.cs and Models/AbstractModel.cs public static / public virtual members; the sim's own count (149 / 185) uses its scaffold's definition

SerializableRun.v0.111.0: schema 20 (V16->V17 ... V19->V20 added; seed hashing change in V18->V19)

decompile_gaps_v0_111_0.pattern: RuntimeHelpers.InitializeArray(.../*OpCode not supported: LdMemberToken*/): static array initializer values unreadable
decompile_gaps_v0_111_0.v0_107_1_tree: renders all of them (e.g. ColossalFlower _prizeCosts = {35, 75, 135}); usable as a cross-reference only, v0.111.0 values need IL or a re-decompile

legacy_corpus_taint_estimate.definition: v0.107.1 combat windows (room_entered ENCOUNTER.* with >= 1 play_card/end_turn) replayed under v0.111.0 rules; a combat is tainted from the first decision at which any card played so far, relic owned, monster present, power seen, orb channeled or potion used is in the rule_diverging or v0.107.1-only list (conservative: every flag counts, no triage)
legacy_corpus_taint_estimate.known_false_positive: monsters:NIBBIT (call-set flag only) although the 4 agreeing v0.107.1 bundles include NIBBITS_WEAK under v0.111.0 rules
